text:
alex: quick sync for 03/24 night window 23:00 UTC. cross-service deploy: api-service -> v2.4.1, runtime -> v3.0.0-rc2 (kv eviction fix), router -> header-swap v5.1 (canary), console -> commit abc123. need final deploy order, rollback owners, and who signs off at canary pause.
maria: staging smoke green for api v2.4.1 and console abc123. runtime-rc2 flaky DB test but perf is within tolerance. https://staging.redwood/ci/9876 :white_check_mark:
sam: noting runtime memory profile up a bit on long sessions. set fallback to v2.9.8 if RSS or restarts spike. also verifying KV cache compatibility with api v2.4.1.
sasha: i'll be oncall for the window. proposed rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.5% over two consecutive 5m windows OR p95 latency >30% above baseline for two windows OR worker restarts >1/min. On trigger we do staged rollback + traffic hold. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: window scheduled 2026-03-24 23:00-23:30 UTC. Preflight checks queued T-45m. Default rollback TTL 30m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 80% over three 10m intervals. Services listed: api-service, runtime, router, console. Automated smoke to #eng-sre on start.
maria: KV format check ok in staging, no migration needed. 10k request test saw zero KV misses.
sam: approved rollback commands (ops pre-approved):
```
# router rollback
ri deploy rollback --service router --to-tag stable-20260324
# runtime rollback
ri deploy rollback --service runtime --to-tag v2.9.8
# api rollback
ri deploy rollback --service api-service --to-tag v2.4.0
```
alex: suggested deploy order: 1) pin api v2.4.1 2) deploy runtime v3.0.0-rc2 3) router header-swap canary v5.1 4) console abc123 after router stable. Rationale: pin API contract early.
sasha: +1. add manual approval gate after 25% router canary (pause for sign-off, T-15). Who approves?
maria: i can approve API and console.
sam: i'll monitor runtime and approve or trigger rollback within canary window if memory/restarts spike.
deploy-bot: preflight: config diff OK, infra capacity OK (20% headroom), schema checks OK. Canary schedule created.
alex: i'll post concise release note to #release-notes at T-30. Rollback criteria and commands are in the notes. Any objections?
sasha: none. i'll alert platform oncall if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:
maria: note: console touches settings A/B flag. we'll keep flag OFF during rollout and flip after router stable to avoid surprises.
sam: adding heapdump endpoint for quick diagnostics: `curl -X POST http://runtime/heapdump` (pre-authorized for oncall).
alex: good. i'll be online for the window. ping here for updates and @deploy-bot will broadcast. :rocket:
